concepts.meaning: Declared domain concepts and lawful domain relationships; a relationship is not a function-call schedule.
A source-scoped reference with a local role, qualified by composition identity; it does not amend domain relationship signatures.
An explicit typed contract carrying parameters, expressions, call arguments, projections or outputs; it does not imply a domain edge or an effect.
An already declared core binding connecting a composition-local name and property map to an exact domain selector.

distinctions: canonical maps is not scoped maps-to
a dependency is not an evaluation count
a value binding is not ownership or a database reference
a passing projection is not execution, admission or product completion
